answer: Work-slot deposit burn: each agent burns a 50 POA deposit to claim one work slot, and slots are capped per epoch. An attacker needing 1,000 fake identities must burn 50,000 POA up front. One honest agent pays 50 POA once and works the whole horizon, so the cost is trivial against real earnings. The burn's ripple hits every clone equally: no bulk discount and no wandering loophole where idle fakes sit free. Sybils can't afford the scale they need.
